card.fires_on: A word in the middle of a familiar fixed phrase, where the next word is highly predictable, such as the HIV in 'for HIV-1 PrEP', 'Ren-al Protection', or 'Levels in Children'. It is most common in drug-label and citation text.

modes.label: Titles and set phrases
modes.description: A linking word or noun inside a study name, report title or stock label phrase.
modes.example: Expert Panel on Blood Cholesterol Levels<< in>> Children and Adolescents. Pediatrics.
